8 ارتخّ , (IAar, TA,) inf. n. اِرْتِخَاخٌ, (IAar, K, TA,) for which, in some copies of the K, is put استرخاخ, but the former is the right reading, (TA,) said of dough, (IAar, TA,) It was, or became, soft, or flaccid. (IAar, K, TA.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) It (one's opinion) was, or became, unsound, faulty, or confused; syn. اِضْطَرَبَ. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
